  "summary": "Removes the CMake configure-time check for SetThreadDescription in Windows builds and unconditionally calls the function on WIN32 platforms.   "problem": "A temporary configure check for SetThreadDescription was added in #36057 to support older Mingw-w64 toolchains prior to branching release 33.x. result.card: Removes the configure-time introspection check for SetThreadDescription and assumes it is available on Windows, documents Mingw-w64 12.0 as the minimum required version, and drops MSVCRT support from the Nix cross-shell. Following the 33.x release branch, master now requires Mingw-w64 >= 12.0, making the compatibility probe introduced in #36057 unnecessary. It is an internal build configuration cleanup and documentation update for Windows cross-compilation.
